text:
Maya K (acct-mgr): FYI evergreen bio wants to go live with a NZ pilot next Tue. They asked for a NZ edge routing + temporary rate uplift while they ramp. Pinged infra but wanted CS sync here.
Raj P (cs-eng): Got it. Do we have expected qps/top token rate for the pilot? and a list of IPs they need whitelisted?
Maya K (acct-mgr): They said 200 qps peak, burst to 400 for first 48h. Token usage ~150k/day. Will share CIDR list in a sec from their infra team.
Tyler S (onboard-eng): 200->400 burst is fine from product side if we put them on the NZ edge pool and enable temporary rate window. Need eng-infra to add a route+allowlist to the nz-edge peering.
Maya K (acct-mgr): CIDRs from Evergreen infra: 203.90.120.0/22, 203.90.124.64/26, 45.77.12.0/24. They also asked for 0-6am local maintenance blackout to avoid rollouts during their demo.
Raj P (cs-eng): copy. I'll open a config request. Also flagging that this customer has a renewal in 10w — Lena, recommended we run a quick enablement session during the pilot to lock value.
Lena V (AM): Yep please book a 30m enablement + Q&A for day 2. I'll prep ROI talking points. Renewal risk medium if onboarding stumbles.
ops-bot: ticket created: INFRA-4932 "NZ edge route + temporary rate window for Evergreen Bio" assigned to eng-infra. ETA 24h.
Tyler S (onboard-eng): For eng-infra: Required changes:
```
1) Add route for customer CIDRs to nz-edge peering
2) Add IP allowlist to front-door (203.90.120.0/22, 203.90.124.64/26, 45.77.12.0/24)
3) Temp rate window: baseline 200 qps, burst 400 qps for 48h starting 2026-04-01T00:00:00+13:00
4) Prevent autoscale-driven maintenance between 00:00-06:00 NZT for pilot window
```
Tyler S (onboard-eng): Also set a soft alert to revert the rate window and remove the exception after 72h unless AM approves extension.
Raj P (cs-eng): Can eng-infra confirm whether this requires a capacity reservation or just routing/ACL changes? If reservation needed, we'll need payment/commit signoff.
eng-infra-bot: INFRA-4932 updated: routing + ACL changes are standard config and do not require reserved capacity. Can implement as infra config change. Will need a manual review for maintenance window exception.
Maya K (acct-mgr): Perfect. I'll forward the pilot schedule and contact at Evergreen.
Lena V (AM): I'll schedule enablement for 2026-04-02 10:00 NZT and add a reminder for renewal check-in.
Raj P (cs-eng): I'll prepare a short runbook for our support team: how to verify edge routing, metrics to watch (latency p50/p95, token burn, rate-limit hits), and rollback steps.
Maya K (acct-mgr): thanks everyone. tagging @eng-oncall if anything pops during rollout window. :raised_hands:
Tyler S (onboard-eng): post-pilot action: capture feedback on prompt latency and any model quality regressions; tie a small eval to the enablement so we can quantify improvements for renewal deck.
Lena V (AM): noted — I'll attach the pilot outcome to the renewal playbook.
ops-bot: INFRA-4932 status -> In progress (claimed by eng-infra). ETA 18h.
